product.ta-20-np.summary: The TA 20-NP distinguished its office workstation with a dot-matrix printer and continuous-form feed.
product.ta-20-np.history: Triumph-Adler offered the NP alongside the SE to automate office work. The model sheet shows it with 8 KiB, an MBKE 2 cassette drive and an EFE 61 feeder.
product.ta-20-np.technical.configuration: Continuous paper made it easier to print forms in batches. The model sheet lists the MKE 6 magnetic ledger-card unit as an upgrade.
product.ta-20-np.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-20-np.technical.limitations: Firmware from an identified unit and program media are still needed to check operation.
